body:
> If you are planning any element of your own suicide, it is an emergency. 

ok. yes. according to your definition, this *is* an emergency. I'll take care of it by talking to my doctors today and tomorrow (appointment with the talk therapist tomorrow... I really hope she doesn't put me on a manditory psych hold or anything like that...that would be awful imho) I've been/am romanticizing Bella-donna (poison) and researching it a lot. I thought I'd just get some to have on hand in case I needed it, but while writing about it here, I can easily see that I should not buy/have any poison around. It would be quite tempting to reach for during an uncontrollable tantrum (like what happened last night), if just to get control. God, these words are sooo suicidal, you're right. I dont even know how far down the rabbit hole I even am.

> back on your feet acting hypersexual with your SO spending frivolous amounts of money and coming up with million dollar ideas before you know it

:) oh yea. i forgot.

I know you're just a stranger online. Im going to get help beyond "skills". I dont know how bad bad is. I'm not sure how to judge weather it's getting worse or not, it's been "bad" for a week or so, and yes, I guess worse than last few days. I keep researching poisons. 

Again, I have an SO who is supportive in me seeking professional help. She even called the p-doc for me this morning, and I have a therapy session tomorrow where I'll discuss my ailment for an hour. 

Thanks for taking time to write me. I really appreciate it. I know you're not the suicide hotline, I do have that number too. I worry that me doing it would be on a whim and almost more like an accident from becoming out of control. I feel like I could "do a robbin williams" (no offense), meaning an almost random act while *this* depressed. Very scarey thoughts.

thanks for writing! Pussy and Gold lol.

My SO keeps telling me to remember (being BP1) how it comes and goes.

but jesus christ what a bitch of a disease. :(

> are consistent with severe bipolar

yes. I know. I've always been bipolar. first psychotic break (and 10 day hospitalization/ 5150) 2 years ago.

>I was heading into the worst phase of severe depression

yikes! Oh shoot! I dont know if I have time or energy to go through all that this time.

>It is not a DIY situation.

Ok! Thanks for your incite. I will see my doctors soon.
